newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NOMURA SAYS PLACED 10 PCT OF INNOGENETICS.
newsitem.headline: NOMURA SAYS PLACED 10 PCT OF INNOGENETICS.

text.p: Nomura Securities said on Tuesday it had placed $25 million worth of Belgian biotech firm Innogenetics at $10.50 per share with institutional investors in the U.K., Switzerland, the Benelux and Scandinavia.

The placing of the equivalent of 10 percent of Innogenetics' issued share capital follows a decision by some of the firm's main shareholders to cut their holdings at the end of the "lock-in" period that began with its IPO on Easdaq last year.
Innogenetics ended Easdaq trade at $10.50, down from $11.125 at Monday's close, with 4,842,648 shares traded.
